decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The roof extension hereby approved shall be built in materials matching the original building and the outbuilding shall be constructed in red/brown sandfaced flettons or such other materials as shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 4 - Continuous glazing manifestations shall be affixed to the rear of the entire glazed frontage of the shop front in such a way as to be permanently visible to persons approaching the premises when it is first installed and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 5 - The illumination levels used in any signage visible from the street shall not exceed levels set out in Technical Report 5 of the Institute of Lighting Engineers - the Brightness of Illuminated Signs.
Condition : 6 - The shopfront hereby approved shall be constructed with a doorway with a minimum opening of 900 mm and a flush threshold

Condition : 7 - The outbuilding shall be used only for storage purpose ancillary to the use of the ground floor shop at 208 Great west Road and shall not be used as separate business or residential accommodation
Condition : 8 - The outbuilding shall have a flat roof not exceeding 2.40m at the maximum height measured from the true ground level.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension and alterations to shopfront creating separate entrance to flat and single storey outbuilding to rear.
